message_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-4d22313d-5822-4ac4-a560-2d1ed51fe2ce-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"object_state","severity":"high","explanation":"同一时刻同一镜片 R4 的玻璃状态与证据矛盾：证据表明 R4 是西侧孔径镜片，而该镜片在 18点 是透明玻璃，不是琥珀玻璃。","reasoning":"当前草稿断言 18点 时 R4 是琥珀玻璃。证据 span-1 在同一时间 18点 确认 R4 就是已安装的西侧孔径镜片，建立了主体同一性；证据 span-2 在同一时间 18点 直接说明西侧孔径镜片是透明玻璃而非琥珀玻璃。两条证据共享同一时间锚点“At 18点 on the same day”，且主体经 span-1 绑定为同一镜片，因此当前断言与证据无法同时成立。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-1","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-1"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-2","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-2","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-2"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","role":"current_context"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-2","role":"prior_state"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is amber glass.","after":"At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is clear glass, not amber glass."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-4d22313d-5822-4ac4-a560-2d1ed51fe2ce-1","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"当前断言与同一时间证据直接矛盾：R4 被确认为西侧孔径镜片，而该镜片在 18点 是透明玻璃而非琥珀玻璃。"}]}
